what: Pre-registration of the second GPU session of Vol.4 with the extraction-service smoke tests of Vol.5; a supplement to prediction_first_batch.json

supplements.kept_from_it: its rules (timed and untimed parts, the gate, start conditions of a timed part, one variable per comparison, raw output outside the repository), its data sets, its metrics and its method (client in a container on the NIM's Docker network, one kept connection, 64 per request, the first 4,096 passages, one discarded pass and three timed passes)

session.card: one RTX 5090 (32 GB), Windows 11 + Docker Desktop (WSL2)
session.window: the night of 2026-10-04, from the freeze of this file; every container of the session is stopped at 08:00 local time on 2026-10-05
session.order: cells 1 to 6 as listed; a cell that cannot start is reported as not run with its reason, and the session goes on
session.containers: named p110_<tag> on the Docker network p110net (scripts/session_step.py sets this; the steps themselves are scripts/run_step.py, unchanged)

added_rule.every_measuring_command_has_a_limit: each command below runs under `timeout` with the number of seconds written beside it; a command that reaches its limit is reported as 'not completed, limit reached' and is not repeated with a longer one in this session
added_rule.why: in the first session one command without a limit held the card for ten minutes

disclosed_about_the_first_session.what: another session on this host ran CPU work from 12:20 to 12:59 on 2026-10-04; the three timed passes of the NIM 2.2.2 cell (12:46:28 to 12:48:27) lie inside that window. The card was not shared.
disclosed_about_the_first_session.consequence: the timed passes of that cell (fp16, miracl-hn-zh) are repeated in cell 5 of this session, next to the fp8 and nvfp4 cells, and both sets of passes are reported
disclosed_about_the_first_session.found_in_the_driver: the internal driver of the first session piped each gate's output through a filter, so a refused gate would not have stopped a cell; all 34 gates of that session passed, so no cell ran against a refusal. The driver of this session sees the refusal (pipefail), and that was checked with a command that fails.

cell_1_zh_version.question: does the reference arm give another nDCG@10 on miracl-hn-zh when only the transformers version changes from 5.5.0 to the stable release of the day the published result is dated (2026-07-07): 5.13.0
cell_1_zh_version.why_this_cell: the published value is 0.64244 and the first session measured 0.66313; while loading, transformers prints that the rope key apply_yarn_scaling of the model is not recognised

release_scan.reading: no release from 5.0.0 to 5.18.0 names the key: the warning cannot be made to disappear by choosing a release. The code of the YaRN function is the same from 5.0.0 to 5.14.0 and the model file is the same from 5.4.0 to 5.14.0.

rope_check.reading: both releases apply the YaRN interpolation of the frequencies and no magnitude correction; the key that is not recognised has the value false in the model's configuration

known_before_the_run_without_the_card.model_config: transformers_version 5.5.0; the downloaded revision is the one of the published result (f880174635613cff04033875fc6a69296cb72006)

environment.name: vol4-reference-tf5130
environment.difference: one line of 47: transformers 5.5.0 -> 5.13.0; torch 2.11.0+cu130, sentence-transformers 5.4.1, tokenizers 0.22.2 and every other package are the same versions

commands.what: encode every query and passage (the first session's command, the other environment)
cosine of every vector with the first session's vector of the same text

branches_decided_in_advance.a: nDCG@10 within 0.005 of 0.64244: the cause is the library version; both values are reported and the published one counts as reproduced with the release of its date
branches_decided_in_advance.b: nDCG@10 still about 0.663: a version cause is not supported; the zh cells stay labelled 'control not reproduced, cause unknown'. No further variant is tried in this session.

cell_1_zh_version.expectation: branch b: nDCG@10 within 0.001 of 0.66313 and every cosine above 0.9999, because the code that computes the positions is the same in both releases
cell_1_zh_version.not_in_this_session: a cell that changes the model's rope settings themselves (plain RoPE, or YaRN with the magnitude correction): asked of the people who assign the work, not decided here

cell_2_three_extraction_nims.what: start each image with the settings of the Blueprint's compose file (v2.6.2), send the Blueprint's own example image twice to /v1/infer, record seconds to ready, the HTTP status, the shape of the answer or the error text, the card's memory

page.profile: the one the image selects; the TensorRT fp16 engine for compute capability 12.0 was fetched beforehand in CPU-only mode

graphic.profile: the one the image selects; the TensorRT fp16 engine for compute capability 12.0 was fetched beforehand in CPU-only mode

table.profile: the one the image selects; the TensorRT fp16 engine for compute capability 12.0 was fetched beforehand in CPU-only mode

cell_2_three_extraction_nims.image_sent: docs/assets/arch_diagram.png of the Blueprint repository at v2.6.2 (SHA-256 cf1bc91d…5b73 as recorded by the first session)
cell_2_three_extraction_nims.both_outcomes_are_results: HTTP 500 like the OCR NIM: the ingestion's extraction step as a whole does not run on this host setup. HTTP 200: the failure is confined to the OCR service.
cell_2_three_extraction_nims.expectation: a guess, with low confidence: HTTP 200 for all three (their settings name CPU threads for pre- and post-processing, which suggests those steps do not hand GPU tensors to a Python model)

cell_3_nemotron_parse.known_before_the_run: the image holds one model profile: engine tensorrt_llm, precision bf16, built on the local card at the first start; it is not a vLLM profile. Its documentation lists H100, A100, L40S and A10G. The weights (3.6 GiB) were fetched beforehand in CPU-only mode.
cell_3_nemotron_parse.condition_in_the_work_order: this smoke test was planned for the case that the image serves through vLLM. It does not; the test is run nevertheless because it costs at most the limit below and its outcome is a fact either way.
cell_3_nemotron_parse.settings: the Blueprint's: NIM_HTTP_API_PORT=8000, NIM_TRITON_LOG_VERBOSE=1, user root, 16 GB of shared memory
cell_3_nemotron_parse.request: POST /v1/chat/completions, model nvidia/nemotron-parse, tool markdown_bbox, the same example image as a data URL, temperature 0; twice

commands.what: start, engine build included, and wait for ready

cell_3_nemotron_parse.recorded: seconds to ready, the card's memory once ready, the HTTP status, the number of elements and their types, the number of characters of text in total (not the text)
cell_3_nemotron_parse.expectation: a guess, with low confidence: the engine build does not finish or fails on this card (not ready within the limit); if it becomes ready, the request answers 200

paddleocr.known_before_the_run: of its nine profiles only the generic ONNX one fits this card; its Python model reads its input from CPU memory and calls no other Triton model; it constructs the recognizer with language en
paddleocr.settings: the Blueprint's (profile paddle): OMP_NUM_THREADS=8, NIM_TRITON_RATE_LIMIT=3, NIM_TRITON_CUDA_MEMORY_POOL_MB=3072, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

ocr_with_the_host_process_namespace.what: the OCR NIM of the first session once more, with `--pid=host` added to docker run and nothing else changed
ocr_with_the_host_process_namespace.why: the Triton issue tracker names `--pid host` as the fix for a failing cudaIpcOpenMemHandle between two containers (issue 3429) and suggests it in a WSL2 report (issue 6220)
ocr_with_the_host_process_namespace.not_tried: overriding FORCE_CPU_ONLY_INPUT_TENSORS: that parameter covers the inputs of a Python model and its default is already the CPU; in this image the GPU tensors are created inside the pipeline's own code (EXTRACTION_NIMS_ON_WSL2.md, sections 2 and 3). Changing the image's code is not done.
ocr_with_the_host_process_namespace.expectation: HTTP 500 with the same error text as before (one container: the two processes share a namespace already)

cell_5_one_variable_precision.rule: two cells of one image that differ in the precision only; same data, same requests, same client; timed passes of both on the same night; speed tables of cells that differ in more than the precision are not put side by side as a comparison

cells: NIM_ENGINE_PRECISION=fp16 (a repeat of the first session's cell, see above)
nemotron_3_embed_1b.branch_decided_in_advance: a precision with which the container does not report ready: its last log lines are the result of that cell
nemotron_3_embed_1b.expectation: fp8: nDCG@10 within 0.005 of fp16 and more passages per second than fp16. nvfp4: a guess with low confidence that it starts; if it does, nDCG@10 within 0.01 of fp16.

cells: NIM_MODEL_PROFILE=2e1ac3d2b2e881b0c86959c09a6ecca58947ac174745f2113203e539ed1310d8 (TensorRT fp16, compute capability 12.0): smoke, timed passes, encode, score
no profile set (the image selects the fp8 profile, as in the first session): smoke and timed passes only, as the same-night partner of the fp16 passes; its quality figures are the first session's
llama_nemotron_embed_1b_v2.expectation: fp16: nDCG@10 within 0.005 of the fp8 cell on each data set; fewer passages per second than fp8; more card memory than fp8

commands_per_cell.what: the timed passes of one data set (gate with --timed right before)
cosine of every vector with the other precision's vector of the same text

cell_5_one_variable_precision.reported_per_cell: precision as the server log names it, nDCG@10, Recall@100, passages per second (median of three passes, all three kept), the card's memory once ready, and the cosine statistics against the other precision

cell_6_whole_corpus.what: every passage of MIRACL zh (4,934,368) encoded with the NIM 2.2.2 pinned to fp16; if zh is finished before 06:00, MIRACL ja is started the same way
cell_6_whole_corpus.not_a_speed: no gate with --timed; the wall time of a piece is recorded and is not a throughput figure. If another program shares the card during the night, the events of this session say so and nothing else changes.
cell_6_whole_corpus.checkpoint: after every 100,000 passages: the vectors of the piece (outside the repository) and one line in results/second_batch/full_corpus/<data set>/checkpoints.jsonl (counts, seconds, SHA-256; no text). A later call goes on from the last line.
cell_6_whole_corpus.check_before_the_run: the program is new, so its first call against the real NIM encodes the first 512 passages of miracl-hn-zh in two pieces; the ids must be those of the first session in the same order and every cosine with the first session's vectors must be at least 0.9999. If not, the whole-corpus run is not started.
cell_6_whole_corpus.limit: the program stops by itself at 08:00; the driver's timeout is the seconds left until 08:00 plus 300; then the container is stopped and removed, the closing gate is run and the card's state is recorded
cell_6_whole_corpus.expectation: from the first session's rate on the reduced zh corpus (about 240 passages per second) the zh corpus needs about 5.7 hours; whether it finishes depends on the hour the cell starts. ja does not finish in this session.
cell_6_whole_corpus.not_in_this_session: any quality figure on the whole corpus

images_not_started_in_this_session: none other than the ones named above
programs_written_after_the_freeze: none planned; if one is needed, its SHA-256 is written to the events file before its first use
